# Evaluating a `const func` imported from Go builds the project's own package
# and runs it: native code with the user's privileges, which nothing between it
# and the OS asks about. So it is never done unasked, and the grant is the
# whole package -- there is nothing finer to grant.
#
# The project is a module of its own, built against this checkout. It starts
# from the checkout's requirements as well, so an offline tidy selects the
# versions the checkout's module cache holds: pruning hides what the
# checkout's tools require, and the graph the evaluator imports alone selects
# older ones nothing downloaded.
exec sh -c 'printf "module example.com/app\n\ngo %s\n\nrequire duckfam.us/sngl v0.0.0\n\nreplace duckfam.us/sngl => %s\n" "$(sed -n "s/^go //p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD")" "${SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD%/go.mod}" > go.mod && sed -n "/^require (/,/^)/p" "$SNGL_HOST_GO_MOD" >> go.mod'
env GOPROXY=off GOFLAGS=-mod=mod
exec go mod tidy
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

# A target that can call the function at run time builds without the value,
# and says so: once per package, at the first call, with the count.
sngl generate --lang=go --platform=bubbletea -o out-go app.sngl
stderr '^warning: app.sngl:4:11: 2 calls into go:example.com/app/lib were not evaluated: running them needs --allow-eval="go:example.com/app/lib" \(or `sngl trust --allow-eval="go:example.com/app/lib"` to record it\)$'
grep 'lib.Shout\("hi"\)' out-go/model.go

# A target that cannot fails, with the same remedy.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr '^app.sngl:4:11: 2 calls into go:example.com/app/lib were not evaluated, and a "none" build cannot call them at run time: running them needs --allow-eval="go:example.com/app/lib" \(or `sngl trust --allow-eval="go:example.com/app/lib"` to record it\)$'
! exists out/index.html

# Allowed, it folds, and the child it runs does not see SNGL_ALLOW.
env SNGL_ALLOW='env=dir:/nowhere=HOME'
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out --allow-eval=go:example.com/app/lib app.sngl
! stderr 'warning'
grep 'hi!' out/index.html
grep 'sees \[\]' out/index.html
env SNGL_ALLOW=

# A value in the store was computed by a run that was allowed, and replaying
# it runs nothing: the warm build needs no grant.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-warm app.sngl
! stderr 'warning'
grep 'hi!' out-warm/index.html

# An edit to the package is a miss, and a miss asks again.
cp lib2.go lib/lib.go
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out app.sngl
stderr 'calls into go:example.com/app/lib were not evaluated'

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import lib "go:example.com/app/lib"

const v = lib.Shout("hi")
const env = lib.Allow()

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
    ui.text(value="sees [{env}]")
}
-- lib/lib.go --
package lib

import "os"

//sngl:pure
func Shout(s string) string { return s + "!" }

//sngl:pure
func Allow() string { return os.Getenv("SNGL_ALLOW") }
-- lib2.go --
package lib

import "os"

//sngl:pure
func Shout(s string) string { return s + "!!" }

//sngl:pure
func Allow() string { return os.Getenv("SNGL_ALLOW") }
-- lib/keep.go --
package lib

// Kept so the module requires what the evaluator imports.
import (
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/lang"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/codegen/platform"
	_ "duckfam.us/sngl/pkg/go/consteval"
)
